The funds raised will be focused towards exploration and Phase 1 field development activities, and working capital.

7F.2 Any other information the entity wishes to provide about the proposed issue
The Placement will be undertaken in two (2) tranches as follows:
(a)        Tranche 1 consisted of the issue of 50,000,000 Placement Shares to unrelated Placement Participants within the
Company's placement capacity under ASX Listing Rule 7.1 and 7.1A on or about 6 August 2026 ; and
(b)        Tranche 2 will consist of the issue of 130,000,000 Placement Shares of which 100,000,000 will be subject to
shareholder approval pursuant to ASX Listing Rule 10.11 to be issued after general meeting.
